text:
anya: Quick check — webinar Tues 11am PT + same-day blog post. Need an SEO runbook: keyword list, meta blurb, JSON-LD snippets (teaser + replay), internal anchors from Resources, and redirects for legacy campaign links. Who takes what?

sam: I'll do keyword map + meta. Initial targets: "LLM inference latency benchmarking", "production LLM serving cost", "enterprise model deployment patterns" — will add long-tail variants and SERP-focused questions.

elaine: I'll own JSON-LD and schema strategy. Teaser = Event schema; gated replay = VideoObject + transcript (noindex). Draft Event snippet for teaser page: 
```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Reducing LLM inference latency: benchmark & playbook","startDate":"2026-03-31T18:00:00Z","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.com/webinars/latency-benchmark-2026"},"performer":{"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference"},"description":"Live demo and replay with benchmark narratives and ops playbook."}
```
I will include a VideoObject on the gated page that points to the hosted video plus transcript (set meta robots noindex, follow).

mike: Redirects owner here. Legacy link: /webinar/latency-2025 -> new teaser /webinars/latency-benchmark-2026. Plan: 302 for previews, flip to 301 after 72h if no issues. nginx rewrite example:
```nginx
# redirect legacy campaign to teaser preserving utm
rewrite ^/webinar/latency-2025$ /webinars/latency-benchmark-2026?utm_source=legacy_campaign permanent;
```
I'll add rows to the central redirect sheet and coordinate with infra for the deploy window.

sam: For canonicalization: public teaser = canonical. Gated replay should be noindex and either rel="canonical" to the teaser or have a clear snippet on the teaser linking to the gated asset. Avoid duplicate content. Also will produce short meta description / benchmark line for SERP.

elaine: Internal linking ops: add 3 anchors from Resources hub — /docs/inference-performance (Benchmarks section), /solutions/enterprise (Deployments callout), and /blog/ops (inline CTA). I'll open PRs on docs + blog and drop links.

seo-bot: Reminder: run pre-index scan 24h before launch (robots.txt, canonical tags, structured data validation). Created ticket MARKETING-SEO-478.

anya: Owners recap: Sam = keywords + meta + solutions copy link; Elaine = JSON-LD + schema checklist + PRs; Mike = redirects + redirect sheet; seo-bot = pre-index scan; Anya = messaging and final page copy. Deliverables due EOD Fri so eng can QA.

mike: I'll post confirmation in the redirect sheet and schedule the 302s tonight. Switching to 301 after 72h if traffic looks normal.

sam: Draft meta: "How Redwood cut LLM inference latency 3x and lowered per-token cost — benchmarks & playbook (webinar + replay)". Will tighten to 155-160 chars.

anya: Also need two CTAs: short teaser CTA (1-5 words) and a longer blog CTA (1-2 sentences). Drop examples in the doc and tag me. Thanks! :rocket:
